verdict.rationale: Grok Build saves every conversation to local disk and documents `grok export` to write a session transcript as Markdown, an open format. Project rules and config use portable conventions (AGENTS.md, TOML) that other tools read. However, export is documented per session only, and there is no documented bulk export of all user data or account-level exit path. Missing for 10: a bulk export of all sessions and data, export of any server-side or account data, a documented account/data deletion path for leaving, and independent hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: `grok export <session-id> [output]` | Export a session transcript as Markdown
Grok saves every conversation to disk automatically — prompts, responses, tool calls, and file snapshots
Put coding conventions, build and test commands, and architecture notes in an `AGENTS.md` at your repo root, and Grok follows them
